ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the route map of cross-regional resource allocation. <image1> What is the main environmental problem faced by the No. 1 resource transfer-out area in the figure?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of cross-regional resource allocation routes with a latitude-longitude grid; multiple arrow-shaped allocation routes can be seen; the No. 1 label is located in the northern inland area of the figure, roughly near the resource transfer-out area in the northwest-leaning northern part of China to the North China area. Then reason: the question asks about the main environmental problem faced by the No. 1 resource transfer-out area. This location corresponds to China’s arid and semi-arid northwest/northern energy resource area, where the ecological environment is fragile, and the main environmental problem is usually land desertification. Therefore the answer is desertification.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有经纬网和多条资源跨区域调配路线，1号位于北部内陆、偏西北—华北一带的资源调出区。再读题干，题目要求判断1号资源调出区面临的主要环境问题。根据该位置对应我国干旱、半干旱的西北/北方能源资源区，判断其主要生态环境问题为荒漠化。
